programme.title: Les Dalton
programme.desc: Au monde des fées, une jeune apprentie tire comme sujet d'examen Joe Dalton ! Pour avoir son diplôme, elle doit réaliser le rêve du bandit : s'évader ! Malheureusement la formule magique n'inclut pas ses frères et Joe se met en quatre pour les emmener avec lui. Comme quoi, même avec l'aide d'une fée, s'évader ne se fait pas en un coup de baguette magique !

programme.title: Les Dalton
programme.desc: C'est le boum de l'immigration et les Dalton ont l'idée de transformer le pénitencier en hôtel. Officiellement, pour renflouer les caisses… Officieusement, bien sûr, pour s'évader. Mais bien vite, leur " brillante " idée va se retourner contre eux : victime de son succès, le Pénitencier Palace Hôtel accueille toujours plus de clients, avec chacun ses exigences ! Comment s'enfuir avec tout ce travail ?

programme.desc: Cette semaine, Sylvain Guillemot se rend chez Gaël, à Cancale, dans les Côtes-d'Armor, avec pour horizon la mer et ses lumières changeantes. Végétarien, Gaël entraîne le chef chez son amie Lucie, maraîchère passionnée par ses terres. Dans sa jolie boutique, Sylvain et Gaël choisissent des patidous, du cresson, des herbes aromatiques, des carottes violettes, des échalotes, des piments et repartent même avec une délicate tartinade maison de lentilles corail et tomates. De retour chez Gaël, un beau chou les inspire : Sylvain propose d'en faire des choux farcis, réinventés avec les trésors du potager. Tandis qu'ils cuisinent, les couleurs se répondent entre l'assiette et le paysage : un arc-en-ciel se dessine au-dessus de la mer, comme un clin d'oeil à cette cuisine vive et généreuse.

programme.desc: Slam est un jeu de lettres et de mots croisés dans lequel les candidats, au buzzer doivent répondre à une série de questions dont la réponse est toujours une lettre. Cette lettre s'affiche ensuite dans une grille partout où elle présente et permet au candidat de débloquer un mot qu'il devra trouver à l'aide d'une définition. Charles, un vieux truand qui vient de passer cinq ans sous les verrous, n'a pas l'intention de reprendre une vie tranquille, aux côtés de sa chère épouse. A peine libéré, il est déjà sur un gros coup : le cambriolage du casino Palm Beach, à Cannes. Pour mener à bien son projet, il est contraint de prendre pour associé Francis, un jeune voyou inexpérimenté qu'il a connu en prison. Les deux malfaiteurs s'installent à Cannes. Louis, le beau-frère de Charles, les rejoint. Charles surveille les salles du casino.

programme.title: Opération Hao
programme.desc: Emmanuelle et Tehau, deux jeunes Polynésiens des Tuamotu, sont engagés dans une formation d'un an au sein du régiment du service militaire adapté récemment installé sur l'atoll de Hao. Emmanuelle, originaire de l'île, et Tehau, venu d'un atoll voisin, y apprennent l'agriculture tropicale et la restauration, avec l'espoir de décrocher un emploi et, peut-être, de se découvrir une vocation de militaire. Leur parcours se déroule sur une île marquée par l'histoire : ancienne base arrière de l'armée pendant les essais nucléaires, prospère puis désertée à son arrêt, Hao cherche aujourd'hui à retenir sa jeunesse.

programme.title: Fenua Vice
programme.desc: Sous le vernis d'un territoire paradisiaque, la Polynésie française abrite un sombre fléau, l'ice, une substance dévastatrice qui dévore les âmes et gangrène les familles. Ce poison, accessible aux jeunes générations, inonde les réseaux sociaux. Depuis la fin des années 1990, ce dérivé de la méthamphétamine s'est propagé dans un silence assourdissant jusqu'à Bora-Bora. Face à ce fléau qui étouffe les voix sous le poids du tabou et pulvérise les valeurs communautaires polynésiennes, chacun tente de tenir debout. Des voix s'élèvent, enfin. Elles prennent la forme d'un mouvement citoyen mobilisé face à l'inaction des pouvoirs publics et au manque cruel de structures adaptées.

programme.title: Journal Météo climat
programme.desc: Un point quotidien sur l'actualité météo et climatique, avec des reportages et des interviews d'experts.

programme.title: La ligne bleue
programme.desc: Gwen Pennarun est un artisan pêcheur de bar qui a réussi à fédérer ses pairs pour lutter contre les dérives de la pêche industrielle et oeuvrer à la sauvegarde de la mer qui les nourrit. Ils défendent un modèle social et économique, et une pêche raisonnée, restant même à quai pendant la période de reproduction du poisson.

programme.title: La p'tite librairie
programme.sub-title: Mon premier été dans la Sierra, de John Muir
programme.desc: Parce que la lecture est et restera l'un des meilleurs moyens de toujours s'évader, François Busnel invite les téléspectateurs à pénétrer dans "La P'tite Librairie". Sur les étagères, on y trouve des romans, des essais, de grands classiques ou des bandes dessinées. En bref, des livres à dévorer sans modération pour faire voyager l'esprit depuis son canapé. François Busnel propose chaque jour de découvrir ou redécouvrir une oeuvre française ou étrangère : roman, essai, grand classique ou encore bande dessinée. Bref, il s'agit là d'une bonne occasion de se mettre à la page.

programme.title: Des racines et des ailes
programme.sub-title: Passion patrimoine : mon île en Normandie
programme.desc: Si Jersey, Guernesey, Sercq, Aurigny sont britanniques, l'archipel de Chausey est resté français. Ces îles ont en commun leur héritage normand et défendent farouchement leur identité. La visite commence sur le chalutier de Malo, 24 ans, l'un des plus jeunes artisans pêcheurs côtiers. Sur Chausey, au début du printemps, Laurence et Vincent retrouvent leur propriété familiale, l'unique hôtel de l'île. À Jersey, après le décès de sa grand-mère, Zoé a tout quitté pour venir travailler avec sa mère dans la ferme familiale. Grâce à l'historienne Sophie Poirey, on découvre ensuite les archives de la Cour Royale à Guernesey. À Sercq, petit territoire de 5km2, Christopher Beaumont, le Seigneur de l'île, perpétue la tradition héritée du Moyen-Âge.

programme.desc: Stopp våpenkappløpetNATO har vedtatt at alle medlemsland skal bruke 5% av BNP på «forsvar» innen 2035. Regjeringen Støre stiller seg bak vedtaket. For Norge betyr det 215 milliarder kroner pr. år. Forstår vi konsekvensene av dette vedtaket?Dagens gjest er Sigurd Allern, professor emeritus i journalistikk og mangeårig redaktør i avisa Klassekampen. Sammen med Roy Pedersen er han redaktør for en ny antologi – Stopp våpenkappløpet – som imøtegår krigspropagandaen om nødvendigheten av den massive opprustningen som vi daglig indoktrineres med i mediene.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Donald Hoffman: Do we see reality as it is?
programme.desc: Cognitive scientist Donald Hoffman is trying to answer a big question: Do we experience the world as it really is ... or as we need it to be? In this ever so slightly mind-blowing talk, he ponders how our minds construct reality for us.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: Civic Tech and the Sad Story of Freedom of Information in Hungary
programme.desc: «Átlátszó,» the word means «transparent» in Hungarian, and it is the name of Hungary's first independent investigative journalism website. A watchdog non-government organisation (NGO) which has experimented with introducing Civic Tech solutions in order to facilitate the work of its team, and also to provide citizens with empowering tools. Since Atlatszo.hu was launched in 2011, the Freedom of Information Act has received a lot of attention, and the legal way for questioning public bodies about spending, a «Freedom of Information request» has become the tool for many to reveal information about corruption.Marietta Le will showcase the use of the free software system Alaveteli, and the use of the Freedom of Information Act in Hungary. The law has been changed since 2011, and the latest news is about a threat that would make access to information much harder for Hungarian citizens. Meanwhile, Atlatszo.hu and many others are trying to implement new Civic Tech solutions in Hungary to help people exercise their democratic rights.Marietta Le is an FOI advocate at Atlatszo.hu Hungarian investigative journalism website. She also works with the K-Monitor anti-corruption NGO as a project coordinator to «Be Smart with Data», a program that facilitates NGOs in producing web apps and visualisations using open data. In 2015 the Hungarian Forbes magazine has featured her on their «30 under 30» list for starting «Jarokelo.hu», a street fixing website in Hungary.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Andy Yen: Think your email's private? Think again
programme.desc: Sending an email message is like sending a postcard, says scientist Andy Yen in this thought-provoking talk: Anyone can read it. Yet encryption, the technology that protects the privacy of email communication, does exist. It's just that until now it has been difficult to install and a hassle to use. Showing a demo of an email program he designed with colleagues at CERN, Yen argues that encryption can be made simple to the point of becoming the default option, providing true email privacy to all.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: Practical Protocol-Oriented Programming in Swift
programme.desc: Value types are at the core of Swift (seriously, mostly everything in the Swift standard library is a value type). But how do you avoid subclassing? That's where the power of Protocol-Oriented programming comes in. Learn how to structure your code to (almost) never subclass again! Practical everyday examples and ideas for your own code base will be included.The speaker Natasha Murashev is an iOS developer by day and a robot by night. She blogs about Swift, WatchOS, and iOS development on her blog, natashatherobot.com, and curates a fast-growing weekly Swift newsletter: This Week in Swift. In her free time, she works on personal projects, speaks at meetups and conferences, contributes to open source, and likes to cross things off her bucket list. She's currently living the digital nomad life as her alter identity: @NatashaTheNomad.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Andreas Ekström: The moral bias behind your search results
programme.desc: Search engines have become our most trusted sources of information and arbiters of truth. But can we ever get an unbiased search result? Swedish author and journalist Andreas Ekström argues that such a thing is a philosophical impossibility. In this thoughtful talk, he calls on us to strengthen the bonds between technology and the humanities, and he reminds us that behind every algorithm is a set of personal beliefs that no code can ever completely eradicate.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Linus Torvalds: The mind behind Linux
programme.desc: Linus Torvalds transformed technology twice — first with the Linux kernel, which helps power the Internet, and again with Git, the source code management system used by developers worldwide. In a rare interview with TED Curator Chris Anderson, Torvalds discusses with remarkable openness the personality traits that prompted his unique philosophy of work, engineering and life. "I am not a visionary, I'm an engineer," Torvalds says. "I'm perfectly happy with all the people who are walking around and just staring at the clouds ... but I'm looking at the ground, and I want to fix the pothole that's right in front of me before I fall in."TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.desc: Martin Johansens hus er ulikt de andre 1960-talls husene i gata; et sju meter høyt påbygg til barndomshjemmet hans. Gunilla Holm Platou er kunstner og mannen Eivind er prisvinnende grafisk designer og illustratør. Småbarnsfamilien bor i en gammel nedlagt togstasjon. Eivind har stått for de smarte både plan-og lagringsløsningene i bygget, i tillegg til at han har snekret og designet mange av husets møbler.

programme.title: 13 timer til å overleve
programme.desc: Gå ned i tidevannsbassenget der et eremittkrabbehus er på jakt, en katthai løper inn til fremmede naboer, og en blekksprut terroriserer byttedyr. Se måker og andre skapninger jakte på overflaten når varmen stiger og oksygen tømmes i bassenget.

programme.title: 13 timer til å overleve
programme.desc: Tell ned sekundene mens solen går ned og rovdyrene sniker seg rundt bassenget før tidevannet endelig kommer sigende. Hold ut når natten kommer med en kleptoman snegle og et akrobatisk kamskjell, mens to slu krabber gjør et farlig forsøk på romantikk.

programme.title: Månens ville side
programme.desc: Utforsk hvordan månefaser setter rytmen for en endeløs konkurranse mellom rovdyr og bytte. Fly i måneskinnet med skjermflygere, fet deg opp på skalldyrfest med makakene, og se en jaktende flokk med løver som prøver å få en babyelefant til middag.

programme.title: Beistets overlevelse
programme.desc: Kryss Namibørkenen med den afrikanske savanneelefanten og lær hvordan de holder seg avkjølt i et område med lite mat og skygge. Finn ut hvordan denne kjempen spiser spesifikke planter, graver brønner og går over utallige sanddyner på jakt etter vann.

programme.title: Månens ville side
programme.desc: Besøk en verden full av romanse og eventyr under stjernene. Forelsk deg i salviejerpens parringsdans, se et par polarrever gjenforenes, flyt blant ynglende fisk på et korallrev, og besøk parringsdammene til smed-trefroskene i måneskinnet.

programme.title: Beistets overlevelse
programme.desc: Finn veien gjennom en mangroveskog på Borneo med saltvannskrokodillen, som er perfekt tilpasset livet blant de våte røttene. Finn ut hvordan dette krypdyret bruker miljøet til å regulere kroppstemperaturen og hvorfor de er så gode jegere.

programme.title: Beistets overlevelse
programme.desc: Undersøk kunsten å bygge rede med jungelens mesterbygger: orangutangen. Følg Max når han prøver å unnslippe den insektfylte skogbunnen i Borneos regnskog, og henter inspirason fra denne enslige primatens naturlige byggeferdigheter.

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Hjelp dyrlege Claire med å ta seg av syke koalabarn, og se hva som skal til for å redde et stripepungdyr fra piggtråd. Ta vare på en utslitt ugle, og få en stor overraskelse når dyrlege Tim tar røntgen av en skilpadde som har blitt påkjørt.

programme.title: Villhunder: Å leve i flokk
programme.desc: Det skjer noe uforutsett ved grensen der Storkekolonien holder til. Gribber, elefanter, bavianer og hyener er bråkete naboer for Manzi-flokken. Kakuli-flokken forsvinner.

programme.title: Afrikas skjulte riker
programme.desc: En smal og ugjestmild landstripe langs vestkysten av det sørlige Afrika er full av kontraster der faunaen er nødt til å tilpasse seg for å overleve. Møt de særegne og karismatiske beboerne som hører hjemme i dette skjøre samspillet mellom land og hav.

programme.title: Ville historier fra gården
programme.desc: Det er vår, og gården yrer av nytt liv. En søye føder tvillinger, en foreldreløs Hereford-kalv strever for å finne en surrogatmor, og lederhønen finner seg til rette i rugekassen sin.

programme.title: Ville historier fra gården
programme.desc: Alle gardsdyra vil nyte sommardagane i enga. Men når instinkta boblar til overflata skapar det kniving blant kvigene. Soay-sauane legg fluktplanar.

programme.title: Ville historier fra gården
programme.desc: Medan lauvet skiftar farge, skiftar dyra lynne. Verane Roger og Hamish duellerer om dominans, og høna Sally er rastlaus.

programme.title: Ville historier fra gården
programme.desc: Sheila sine ni grisungar lagar liv og røre i elles keisame vinterdagar. Veren Hamish gjer kur på Bonnie, men ho er ikkje så interessert.

programme.title: Deep in the Heart
programme.desc: Se verden gjennom øynene til steinbit, ozelot og andre naturlig hjemmehørende skapninger sammen med forteller Matthew McConaughey. La deg imponere av landskapet og dyrelivet i Texas, og lær hvordan livsviktig bevaringsarbeid kan redde de unike habitatene i delstaten.

programme.title: Tidevannets rike
programme.desc: Lavvannet blottlegger en kyststripe som kalles tidevannssonen. Her finnes det utrolige ytterpunkter som angripes av bølger med en orkans styrke og utsettes for stekende hete. Dyrene her har utviklet seg på utallige merkelige måter. Forskere ser nærmere på dette fremmede riket.

programme.title: Mekongs mysterier
programme.desc: Kilden til Mekongelven er høyt oppe på det tibetanske platået. Derfra renner den inn i Yunnan-provinsen i Kina, der vår reise begynner. Selv om Yunnan opptar mindre enn 4 % av Kinas areal, huser den over halvparten av landets fugler og pattedyr.

programme.title: Mekongs mysterier
programme.desc: Bratte fjell og tropiske monsuner definerer Mekongs elvedal på sin vei gjennom Laos. Få et glimt av dyrelivet som har funnet sin plass i det livlige økosystemet, fra bjørnemakaker til terneisfugler og svartgibboner.

programme.title: Mekongs mysterier
programme.desc: Det tempererte nord møter de tropiske sør langs Mekongs bredd i Thailand. Følg elven gjennom Det gylne triangel og see paringsdansene til regionens mangfoldige fuglearter. Få deretter med deg en festival til ære for vannåndene.

programme.title: Mekongs mysterier
programme.desc: Utforsk de flotte grottene i Khammaouane-provinsen i Laos. Disse naturlige underverkene er kilt mellom Mekongelven og Trường Sơn-fjellene, og huser deltids- og heltidsbeboere, slik som flaggermus, geckoer, frosker og gigantiske tusenben.

programme.title: Mekongs mysterier
programme.desc: Der Mekongelven glir ned Thailands grense mot øst, former den landskapet og lager hundrevis av små vannveier gjennom jungelen. Ta en vandretur gjennom området der rhesusaper, elefanter og flyvende hunder lever i harmoni ved elvens bredd.

programme.title: Korallbyen

programme.title: Steinway & Sons
programme.desc: Go behind the scenes at the Steinway & Sons factory and discover Spirio, the incredible technology that allows a piano to replay a performance exactly as it was played live. Mr. Guido Zimmermann, the president of the world-famous pianomakers, talks us through the revolutionary concept, accompanied by images of the precise, fascinating craftmanship and engineering that goes into each one of the Spirio pianos. Hugo Cohen Sprung's documentary also allows us insight into French pianist and Steinway artist Bertrand Chamayou's experience with the technology and features a preview of his unique two-piano concert in which he performs with his "shadow"!

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Léonard à la National Gallery de Londres
programme.desc: Un événement remarquable s'est produit à la National Gallery de Londres lorsque la plus grande collection jamais constituée de peintures de Léonard de Vinci a été réunie dans une exposition unique : Léonard de Vinci : peintre à la cour de Milan. Léonard est reconnu comme étant peut-être le plus grand peintre et sculpteur de tous les temps, mais ses talents ne s'arrêtaient pas là. Ce film raconte sa vie et s'étend sur Léonard le visionnaire, Léonard l'inventeur. Depuis l'endroit où il a vécu ses dernières années au Château du Clos Lucé en France, nous verrons que Léonard de Vinci était peut-être l'incarnation même de l'esprit de la Renaissance.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Between 1883 and 1926 Claude Monet lived in a house at Giverny where he created a flower garden and a water garden, which provided the inspiration for his series of paintings known as the “Water Lilies”. The “Water-Lily Pond” portrays this garden, with its water lilies and the Japanese bridge in the background. In the series of eight large canvases on the theme, housed in the Musée de l’Orangerie in Paris, Monet introduces variations in light according to the hour of the day.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: A tall tower in the heart of Copenhagen, the RADISSON SAS ROYAL HOTEL is both a grand modern hotel and an airline terminal, marking Denmark's entry into post-war modernity. It was a major work of the 1950s, under the banner of functionalism, simplicity and elegance. This total work of art, where everything from the ashtray to the volume of the building was conceived and designed by the same man, Arne Jacobsen, the great Scandinavian architect and designer.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: En 1995, la Ville de Luxembourg décide de faire bâtir une grande salle de concert sur le plateau de Kirchberg, le nouveau quartier des banques et des grandes institutions européennes.L’enjeu de la commande est de réunir trois espaces publics majeurs de représentation dans un même ensemble, une grande salle philharmonique, une petite salle de musique de chambre et un espace découverte. L’architecte Christian de Portzamparc, secondé admirablement par l’expérience de l’acousticien Xu Yaying, fait de cette salle son grand instrument de musique. De forme elliptique, la Philharmonie avec son filtre de colonnes blanches et ses falaises colorées fait découvrir le grand auditorium comme un véritable joyau dans son écrin, un des plus beaux bâtiments de l’architecte.

programme.title: Firemen of Paris: saving Notre-Dame!
programme.desc: The fire at Notre-Dame de Paris on April 15, 2019, shocked the world. The flames ravaged the cathedral's roof and threatened to destroy its historic heritage, including its precious stained-glass windows and millennia-old sculptures.The firefighters worked tirelessly to bring the blaze under control, managing to save the main structure and some of the most precious relics.The incident sparked a massive wave of international solidarity, with pledges of funding for the reconstruction of this iconic building, which is a symbol of French culture and history.

programme.title: China-France: Glory of civilizations
programme.desc: As of the 17th century, Chinese objects fascinated the kings of France while French tapestries and astronomical instruments impressed Emperor Kangxi's China. A look back at four centuries of artistic dialogue between East and West, in the magnificent settings of the Palace of Versailles, the Forbidden City and Jingdezhen.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En juin 2017, une grande exposition a ouvert à Paris au musée d’Orsay. Pour la première fois, cette exposition a réuni tous les portraits de Cézanne. Cela a été l’occasion d’analyser l’œuvre de Cézanne à l’aide d’experts internationaux et de parcourir les salles de la National Portrait Gallery de Londres et de la National Gallery of Art de Washington.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Antonio Canal, known as Canaletto, and Francesco Guardi are the best known 18th century painters of the urban Venetian landscape. In minute detail, they painted iconic views of the Venetian Republic, destined for rich foreign visitors. “Maria della Salute from the Grand Canal in Venice” by Canaletto and “Venice: Piazza San Marco” by Guardi followed this trend. Later Venice also inspired Paul Signac’s “The Green Veil, Venice”. Go on a voyage of discovery...Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Phil Grabsky, réalisateur récompensé à plusieurs reprises, pose un regard neuf sur celui qui est sans conteste l’artiste le plus aimé au monde en utilisant les mots du peintre lui-même. Moi, Claude Monet révèle de nouvelles facettes de l’homme qui a donné naissance au mouvement impressionniste grâce à un tableau et qui fut certainement l’un des peintres les plus influents et renommés du XIXe et du début du XXe siècle. Tourné à travers l’Europe, sur les lieux où il a peint, Moi, Claude Monet est une exploration filmique inédite et intime de certains des décors cultes les plus appréciés de l’art occidental.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: « Les Tournesols » sont parmi les tableaux de Van Gogh les plus célèbres. Le musée Van Gogh à Amsterdam a consacré une exposition à ces œuvres et « Exhibition on screen », qui a eu un accès exclusif à l’événement, nous guide à travers l’exposition pour enquêter sur les mystères qui entourent ces tableaux. Le film nous amènera également à Tokyo, Philadelphie, Londres et Munich pour suivre les 5 principales œuvres de l’exposition.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: 200 years after it opened and a century after acquiring its first Van Gogh works, the National Gallery hosted the largest Van Gogh exhibition ever held in the UK (September 14, 2024 to January 19, 2025). The exhibition was a huge success, unanimously praised by the press, and tickets sold out quickly, making this film the only way to see what Forbes called a “once-in-a-lifetime exhibition.”Discover the passion that drove one of the world's most beloved artists to revolutionize art. Van Gogh: Poets & Lovers rewrites history and celebrates Van Gogh's genius without exploiting his suffering, allowing audiences to truly understand this iconic artist in a whole new way...

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: « J’envie les Japonais », écrivait Van Gogh à son frère, Théo. Grâce à l’exposition sur laquelle est basé ce film, « Van Gogh et le Japon », au musée Van Gogh d’Amsterdam, on comprend pourquoi. Bien que Vincent van Gogh n’ait jamais visité le Japon, il reste le pays qui a eu le plus d’influence sur lui et son œuvre. En se rendant dans les galeries d’art japonais à Paris et en créant sa propre image du Japon après des recherches approfondies, des collections d’estampes et de longues discussions avec d’autres artistes, la découverte des œuvres japonaises entraîna la carrière de Van Gogh dans une nouvelle direction très excitante.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.desc: Les chefs télévisés Aldo Zilli et Ching He-Huang s’affrontent lors de ce Road Trip à travers le sud-est de l’Angleterre, accompagnés des experts Natasha Raskin et Paul Laidlaw.Aldo mise sur une bague en or malgré les conseils des experts, tandis que Ching espère que des antiquités d’origine orientale feront un beau score aux enchères dans le nord de Londres.En chemin, Aldo fait une halte pour rencontrer Jill, une doyenne de 200 ans qui fournissait autrefois la population en farine. De son côté, l’amoureuse des animaux Ching découvre l’histoire d’un homme qui, au XIXe siècle, a risqué le ridicule et la ruine pour protéger le bétail.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: It’s a journey into antiquity with glamorous historians Suzannah Lipscomb and Kate Williams. Paired with experts David Harper and Catherine Southon they Road Trip from Bletchley in Buckinghamshire to an auction in London. There’s also opportunity to hear how Mrs Beeton became the first ‘domestic Goddess’ and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were de rigueur daily wear. David and Suzannah gamble on a giant ant while Catherine and Kate plump for a very large tea urn.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Vandalised, stolen, cut into pieces, melted down and resold for a few thousand euros, even though they are worth millions: sculptures. On the night of 30–31 March 1999, whilst this park in the 6th arrondissement was closed to the public, individuals stole the sculpture of Picasso’s former muse and lover, Dora Maar: ‘Head of a Woman’, an 80-centimetre-tall bronze weighing 80 kilos. Two years later, in a town hall in the Paris suburbs, it stood proudly on the staircase: ‘Do you realise you’ve got a Picasso in your building?’ exclaimed an antique dealer who had come to visit the château. Indeed, the town hall had found a ‘large stone’ buried on a plot of land, had it cleaned, thought it was beautiful and displayed it in their château, unaware that it was a sculpture by Picasso….

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: Alley of Poplars by Sisley, Nice Museum of Fine Arts
programme.desc: Sisley was a British Impressionist painter, closely associated with Renoir and Monet. On 20 June 1978, at 8.30 pm, a truck was stolen. Inside were around ten masterpieces worth 1.5 billion francs. The transport company responsible for returning the works following a loan had made no security arrangements. On 21 September 1998, ‘The Avenue of Poplars’ was stolen once again. This time, it was the curator of the Musée des Beaux-Arts in Nice, Jean Fornéris, who staged his own abduction! Finally, on Sunday 5 August 2007, five masked and armed men held up staff at the Nice museum to steal four paintings, including the Sisley. It was not until 2008, with the help of the FBI – which was also searching for works stolen from the Boston Museum – that the thieves were arrested.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Painted by the Van Eyck brothers, ‘The Adoration of the Mystical Lamb’ or ‘The Ghent Altarpiece’ is regarded as one of the greatest masterpieces of the Flemish Primitives. Installed in St Bavon’s Cathedral in Ghent as early as 1432, it escaped theft and looting on several occasions, However, on the night of 10–11 April 1934, two panels were stolen, one of which – ‘The Just Judges’ – has never been recovered to this day, because the bishop refused to pay the ransom demanded….

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: On the night of 17–18 October 1984, three criminals broke into the municipal museum in Semur-en-Auxois, which was not fitted with an alarm system. The joint investigation by the French and Japanese police revealed links between the Parisian underworld and the Japanese Yakuza mafia. Indeed, Shinchi Fujikuma, a Japanese gangster, had met two members of the Aubervilliers gang, Philippe-Emile Jamin and Youssef Khimoun, whilst serving time in a French prison. In 1987, the French managed to return from Japan with four of the five stolen paintings. The last one, *The Portrait of Mrs Baudot*, remained with its new owner, in accordance with the principle of ‘good faith’ guaranteed by Japanese law.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: L'hôtel Van Eetvelde, une maison particulière de trois étages, construite entre 1895 et 1897, à Bruxelles, Avenue Palmerston. L'homme qui l'a fait construire: Edmond Van Eetvelde, un haut fonctionnaire dont la carrière est en pleine ascension. Pour construire sa maison, Van Eetvelde choisit Victor Horta, un jeune archi-tecte d'avant garde, l'un des créateurs du mouvement de l'art nouveau.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Strictly Come Dancing’s Zoe Ball and Ian Waite are quickstepping their way across the south West of England in a bid to turn a profit at auction in Hampshire. Experts Margie Cooper and Paul Laidlaw are on hand to guide. Paul shares a secret with Zoe about buying antique hair brushes. Ian, though, offers dancing lessons to dealers to secure a discount. Lordy! Zoe also hears how one village became world famous for lace production while Ian ends up meeting a giant horse with its own boat.

programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of an Italian painter, Titien. You will discover his labour with Pastoral concert, The resurrection of Christ or Venus with organist.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Georges Seurat. You will discover his labour with « Ile de France » landscape, Study for « a Sunday afternoon at the grande jatte », Study for « La grande jatte ».

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Hopper’s work is the most recognisable art in America – popular, praised, and mysterious. Countless painters, photographers, filmmakers and musicians have been influenced by his art – but who was he, and how did a struggling illustrator create such a bounty of notable work?This new film takes a deep look into Hopper’s art, his life, and his relationships. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: A key artist of the Italian Renaissance, Raffaello Santi (1483-1520) developed a classical art form, based on drawing, which made him the model for many painters in the following centuries. His favourite theme was the Madonna: you can admire, for example, “The Sistine Madonna” in Dresden and the “The Virgin and Child with St John the Baptist” in the Louvre. Notice the gentle harmony and the delicate sensuality in “The Three Graces” or the powerful human presence in “The Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione”.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: La Dulwich Picture Gallery abrite une collection au destin incroyable ! En 1790, le roi de Pologne passa commande à deux marchands d’art installés à Londres. Ceux-ci achetèrent des peintures à travers l’Europe, qui restèrent en leur possession après l’effondrement de la Pologne. Ils léguèrent la collection au Dulwich College et, selon leur vœu, le premier musée d’art public anglais ouvrit ses portes en 1817. Découvrez ainsi des chefs d’œuvres de la main de Poussin, Rembrandt ou Murillo. Bonne visite !

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: L'usine Menier à Noisiel fut entre 1870 et 1914 la plus grande chocolaterie du monde. Mais ce fut aussi et surtout une usine pionnière en matière d'innovation architecturale. Son architecture de fer puis de béton voulait symboliser la puissance et la modernité de l'entreprise. Ses trois bâtiments majeurs, le moulin Saulnier, la première construction à charpente entièrement métallique du monde, la Halle Eiffel et la Cathédrale racontent à leur manière l'âge d'or de l'architecture industrielle.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Narrated by Gillian Anderson, this episode of Exhibition on Screen follows the footsteps of French artists such as Renoir and Monet, the American Impressionist movement forged its own path. Painted over a period of 40 years, these paintings reveal the United States both as a nation and as a creative breeding ground. The history of this movement is closely linked to the love of gardens and the desire to preserve nature in a country undergoing rapid urbanization. This enchanting journey through workshops, gardens and famous sites in the USA, UK and France is a feast for the eyes.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery in London is one of the world’s greatest art galleries. It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Le collectionneur danois : de Delacroix à Gauguin
programme.desc: Wilhelm Hansen fut un homme d’affaires visionnaire, qui vécut au Danemark au XIXème siècle. Il fut l’un des rares collectionneurs à s’intéresser aux peintres impressionnistes, à une époque où ils étaient attaqués et dénigrés. Le film nous amène dans la maison d’été de Hansen dans la banlieue de Copenhague et nous fait visiter l’extraordinaire exposition à la Royal Academy de Londres consacrée à sa collection.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Au 16ème siècle, le cardinal Scipione Borghèse, neveu du Pape, fait construire une villa pour accueillir spécialement sa collection privée d’œuvres d’art, l’une des plus importantes de l’époque. Achetée par l’Etat italien en 1902, cette collection d’une immense richesse rassemble des chefs d’œuvres inestimables signés par les plus grands artistes. Découvrez ainsi l’une des copies de Léda et le cygne de De Vinci ou le David de Caravage. Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Genre pictural existant depuis l’Antiquité, la nature morte connut un regain d’intérêt à partir du XVIIe siècle dans la peinture européenne. Représentation composée d’éléments inanimés, elle peut se limiter à la table d’un repas, comme dans le frugal Dessert de gaufrettes de Lubin Baugin, ou d’animaux chassés comme dans la Nature morte au faisan de Jean-Baptiste Oudry. Retrouvez également des natures mortes célèbres de Chardin, Cézanne et Van Gogh.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Actor and charmer Nigel Havers and his canny, deal-making chum (and ex-agent) Michael Whitehall explore the West Country. Travelling by Bentley and TVR, they’ll have £400 each and expert advice from Margie Cooper and James Braxton. But what will do best at the auction... Nigel’s old cockle bucket or Michael’s tambourine? Plus there’s a trip to see some Bristol Savages and bit of Georgian elegance with the story of ‘The King of Bath’.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux amies de la scène et de la télévision, Ruth Madoc et Su Pollard, connues pour leurs apparitions dans la sitcom Hi-De-Hi, partent à la chasse aux antiquités avec Phil Serrell et Raj Bisram. Partis de Monmouth, ville frontalière du Pays de Galles, ils se rendent à Congleton, dans le Cheshire, pour une vente aux enchères.Ruth découvre également l'incroyable infirmière du XIXe siècle - et ce n'est pas Florence Nightingale - tandis que Su visite l'ancienne ville romaine de Caerleon et trouve le temps d'affronter Phil dans un amphithéâtre.Et Su tente de résoudre un vieux mystère... Phil porte-t-il une perruque ?

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The Impressionists are the most popular group in art history - millions flock every year to marvel at their masterpieces. But, to begin with, they were scorned, penniless outsiders. 1874 was the year that changed everything; the first Impressionists, “hungry for independence”, broke the mould by holding their own exhibition outside official channels. Impressionism was born and the art world was changed forever.What led to that first groundbreaking show 150 years ago? Who were the maverick personalities that wielded their brushes in such a radical and provocative way? The spectacular Musée d’Orsay exhibition brings fresh eyes to this extraordinary tale of passion and rebellion. The story is told not by historians and curators but in the words of those who witnessed the dawn of Impressionism: the artists, press and people of Paris, 1874. See the show that changed everything on the big screen.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top Italian cooks Antonio Carluccio and Gennaro Contraldo are on a Road Trip around East Anglia. Restaurateurs, writers and old friends the ‘greedy Italians’ will be foraging for antiques in the company of experts David Harper and James Braxton. Watch out for some ‘explosive’ bargaining and an extremely tasty risotto! When he’s not shopping Antonio learns about the brave fisherman of Suffolk who saved mariners’ lives while risking their own. And, Gennaro has a trip to take a peek at a very special bird.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Lucian Freud, l'un des peintres britanniques les plus célèbres de notre époque, est également l'un des rares artistes du XXe siècle à s'être représenté dans un autoportrait avec une telle constance. Ses autoportraits donnent un aperçu fascinant à la fois de sa personnalité et de son évolution en tant que peintre, depuis son premier portrait peint en 1939 jusqu'au dernier. Grâce à des entretiens fascinants avec d'anciens modèles, des amis et d'éminents experts, ce documentaire intensément captivant révèle l'œuvre d'un maître qui représente une étude captivante sur la dynamique du vieillissement et le processus d'autoreprésentation.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux légendes de la comédie britannique, Ronni Ancona et Jan Ravens, sont accompagnées des antiquaires Phil Serrell et James Braxton pour ce Road Trip. Partant de la ville de Redcar, dans le North Yorkshire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stockport, dans le Cheshire.Jan se laisse emporter et dépense tout son budget, tandis que Ronni se régale d'une paire de bottes en verre très kitsch.Lors d'un détour, Jan découvre pourquoi les habitants de Hartlepool pensaient qu'un singe était un Français, et Ronni reste bouche bée lorsque Braxton enlève ses vêtements. Sacré moment !

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Lucian Freud, l'un des peintres britanniques les plus célèbres de notre époque, est également l'un des rares artistes du XXe siècle à s'être représenté dans un autoportrait avec une telle constance. Ses autoportraits donnent un aperçu fascinant à la fois de sa personnalité et de son évolution en tant que peintre, depuis son premier portrait peint en 1939 jusqu'au dernier. Grâce à des entretiens fascinants avec d'anciens modèles, des amis et d'éminents experts, ce documentaire intensément captivant révèle l'œuvre d'un maître qui représente une étude captivante sur la dynamique du vieillissement et le processus d'autoreprésentation.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Two favourite Blue Peter presenters Sarah Greene and Peter Duncan are in the company of Natasha Raskin and Catherine Southon as they hunt for antiques around Surrey, Hertfordshire and North West London. Peter detours to learn how hockey became a popular sport the world over while keen aviator Sarah sees how the Battle of Britain was won. An incredible haul of antiques, including chimney pots, Pinocchio and a pair of African fertility figures, go under the gavel at an auction in Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire.

programme.title: China - Masters of the Arts
programme.desc: Mastering the brightest colors, brought to life in kilns where fires roar at extreme temperatures, the artist paints on enamel scenes celebrating the heroic deeds of the most iconic figures from Chinese cosmogony and tradition. The flames are so intense that the kilns are named after dragons. From Mulan to the concubine of the famous warrior Ba Wang Bie Ji, the dynasties of Chinese emperors parade before our eyes across the centuries.

programme.title: Travelers
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, Travelers vous emmène à Genève en Suisse, le pays des montres, du chocolat et de la fondue, mais également des musées, de l’ONU. Nous commencerons notre visite par la vieille ville. Nous visiterons le musée d’ethnographie de Genève, le Namco musée d’art contemporain. Nous testerons également la véritable fondue au fromage suisse.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: Looting of the Gentili Di Giuseppe Collection
programme.desc: Federico Gentili di Giuseppe was a Jewish businessman of Italian origin with a passion for art. On his death in 1940, he bequeathed a collection of 150 paintings to his two children, Marcel and Adriana, who had become naturalised French citizens. In 1941, Maître Moulin auctioned off these paintings under questionable circumstances. This marked the beginning of a legal battle waged by the Gentili di Giuseppe heirs, which was to last nearly 50 years.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: Alley of Poplars by Sisley, Nice Museum of Fine Arts
programme.desc: Sisley was a British Impressionist painter, closely associated with Renoir and Monet. On 20 June 1978, at 8.30 pm, a truck was stolen. Inside were around ten masterpieces worth 1.5 billion francs. The transport company responsible for returning the works following a loan had made no security arrangements. On 21 September 1998, ‘The Avenue of Poplars’ was stolen once again. This time, it was the curator of the Musée des Beaux-Arts in Nice, Jean Fornéris, who staged his own abduction! Finally, on Sunday 5 August 2007, five masked and armed men held up staff at the Nice museum to steal four paintings, including the Sisley. It was not until 2008, with the help of the FBI – which was also searching for works stolen from the Boston Museum – that the thieves were arrested.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Vandalised, stolen, cut into pieces, melted down and resold for a few thousand euros, even though they are worth millions: sculptures. On the night of 30–31 March 1999, whilst this park in the 6th arrondissement was closed to the public, individuals stole the sculpture of Picasso’s former muse and lover, Dora Maar: ‘Head of a Woman’, an 80-centimetre-tall bronze weighing 80 kilos. Two years later, in a town hall in the Paris suburbs, it stood proudly on the staircase: ‘Do you realise you’ve got a Picasso in your building?’ exclaimed an antique dealer who had come to visit the château. Indeed, the town hall had found a ‘large stone’ buried on a plot of land, had it cleaned, thought it was beautiful and displayed it in their château, unaware that it was a sculpture by Picasso….

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: The Boy with a Soap Bubble, Rembrandt
programme.desc: On the evening of 13 July 1999, a day of celebrations in France, Rembrandt’s *The Boy with a Soap Bubble* disappeared from the Draguignan Municipal Museum. Patrick Vialaneix recounts how he fell in love with this painting at the age of 13. Thirteen years later, the painting continued to haunt him, and he decided to steal it so that he could always have it close to him and talk to it. He therefore hid in a cupboard in the museum, waiting for nightfall to make off with it. He turned himself in to the police in 2014.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Joyau de géométrie et de rigueur, cette bibliothèque est l'un des derniers chefs-d'œuvre de Louis Kahn. En disposant les lecteurs sur la périphérie du bâtiment, près de la lumière du jour, et en créant un immense hall central, Louis Kahn réinvente le plan de la bibliothèque. Achevée en 1971 dans la petite ville d'Exeter, dans l'État américain du New Hampshire, la bibliothèque de l'Exeter Academy forme un mystérieux monolithe de brique aux 4 façades identiques sur 8 étages.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: François Boucq draws from morning to night in his studio, alone, as if he wanted to be more closely involved with his characters, moving from the savagery of the American West to the diplomacy of the Vatican, from the urban jungle to the news of the daily press. He has been drawing for 40 years with realism, with a precise and detailed line, a graphic finesse that makes him one of the undisputed masters of today's comics.

programme.title: Health Investigation
programme.desc: In France, 30 per cent of adults and 50 per cent of older people are affected by high blood pressure. This excessively high blood pressure in the arteries can lead to strokes, heart attacks, kidney failure or dementia.The World Health Organisation ranks high blood pressure, known as the ‘silent killer’, as the second greatest health risk, just behind smoking. Being overweight, a lack of physical activity, smoking, a diet that is too high in salt and stress are all contributing factors.More often than not, high blood pressure presents no symptoms, making it difficult to detect. Whilst many patients are unaware that they have high blood pressure, conversely, others are wrongly classified as ‘sick’.This is because blood pressure fluctuates constantly and can lead to misdiagnosis. A bout of stress or physical exertion can cause blood pressure to rise. Another factor that can skew the reading is the ‘white coat’ effect, linked to the stress of the consultation. programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Nous entamerons ce périple près de la Rochelle pour en apprendre un peu plus sur l’élevage des fameuses moules de bouchot mais aussi une technique bien particulière pour les cuisiner. Nous partirons ensuite pour un tour de France des meilleures huîtres : direction Cancale, Arcachon, Montpellier et enfin Oléron pour connaître les différentes méthodes d’élevage et s’y retrouver un peu plus parmi toutes les espèces de l’hexagone. Julie cuisinera une fricassée de berniques, les petits chapeaux chinois qui recouvrent les rochers du littoral mais aussi des palourdes roses méconnues du grand public. Nous poursuivrons notre route dans le Finistère pour rencontrer Sylvain, le seul éleveur d’ormeau du pays puis à Méru où se trouve encore des ateliers magnifiant ce sublime matériau. Le Chef Jean-Marie Baudic nous cuisine les coquilles Saint-Jacques comme personne.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Honey was the first sweet condiment in history! It has also been known and consumed as a remedy since Antiquity. In France, we find an infinite variety of honey: acacia, chestnut, fir, rosemary, orange, spruce, oak, linden or lavender... We'll cross forests, fields and even towns, as bees also forage in urbanized areas. We'll then cook up emblematic recipes like Vercel gingerbread. Finally, we'll discover the European dark bee. Protecting this 80-million-year-old bee has become the spearhead of some passionate beekeepers.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, we're off to discover summer fruits, which are harvested from June to August: peaches, melons, strawberries, raspberries... We'll then head to the cherry capital, Céret, and cook blueberries, strawberries and an apricot charlotte.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive.

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, les plus gourmands ne devraient pas être déçus puisque c’est le chocolat qui est mis à l’honneur. Découvert par les mayas il y 2500 ans et plus largement ensuite par les Aztèques, le chocolat fait partie aujourd’hui des produits préférés des français. Et qu’on ne s’y trompe pas : au même titre que la cuisine a ses grands chef, le chocolat a aussi ses grands chocolatiers. Coté recettes, Julie fera découvrir un gâteau qu’on ne fait qu’à Saint Émilien et qui associe le chocolat au macaron, avant de rejoindre le Pays Basque pour un dessert qui ne manque pas de piment. Nous grimperons ensuite en montagne à la rencontre d’une cuisinière d’origine suisse qui fait des pains au chocolat à sa façon. Enfin, vous verrez que le chocolat nous réserve de nombreuses surprises : il possède de nombreuses vertus et s’utilise aussi pour le bien être.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Tendre et savoureux, l’agneau tient une place prépondérante dans la cuisine festive mais aussi dans celle de tous les jours. Du Pays Basque au Cotentin en passant par Paris, Julie part donc sur les routes de France à la découverte des différentes races et types d'élevage existant à travers le pays. Il faut dire que la France a l'une des productions les plus variées au monde. Il existe plus d'une quarantaine de races répertoriées en 5 catégories : précoces, d’herbage, rustiques, mérinos et laitières. Mais plus qu’à la race, c’est à la façon dont ils sont alimentés qui intéresse les fins connaisseurs. Julie nous fait découvrir ses producteurs et cuisiniers de ce met raffiné !

programme.desc: It's off to the start of the first week of competition. But before the four amateur decorators take their turn with paintbrushes and nails, they have a meeting in the Brussels workshop. To kick off this week's competition, Armand, 33, is in the starting blocks. This young man from Montpellier is determined to prove that he is the ace decorator and no one else. Our competitor has the advantage of having a good dose of inspiration. And yes, as well as creating costumes, Armand has several great passions. This week's theme is wood. Will our man from Montpellier succeed in keeping to this theme, which is full of pitfalls?

programme.title: Home training

programme.desc: Cet épisode de "Fais ton sport à la maison" est dédié au renforcement musculaire du haut du corps. La séance alterne entre deux exercices debout et deux au sol, intégrant une touche de cardio pour intensifier le travail. Ce programme complet et dynamique permet de renforcer la partie supérieure du corps tout en améliorant la mobilité.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C'est à Giverny que démarre le voyage de Julie, celui dont le nom résonne immédiatement comme le berceau de l’Impressionnisme a gardé une authenticité émouvante, Giverny impose son style, murmure son histoire. Sa notoriété est fortement liée à la présence historique de Claude Monet et à tous les fabuleux témoins laissés par ce dernier. Claude Monet a aussi laissé son empreinte dans la cuisine à Giverny. Ses carnets de recettes sont là pour en témoigner. C’est dans ces carnets que Julie va s’inspirer pour remplir le sien, au menu : Lapin en compote, feuilleté d’andouilles au camembert, et charlottes aux abricots.

programme.title: Health Investigation
programme.desc: In France, 30 per cent of adults and 50 per cent of older people are affected by high blood pressure. This excessively high blood pressure in the arteries can lead to strokes, heart attacks, kidney failure or dementia.The World Health Organisation ranks high blood pressure, known as the ‘silent killer’, as the second greatest health risk, just behind smoking. Being overweight, a lack of physical activity, smoking, a diet that is too high in salt and stress are all contributing factors.More often than not, high blood pressure presents no symptoms, making it difficult to detect. Whilst many patients are unaware that they have high blood pressure, conversely, others are wrongly classified as ‘sick’.This is because blood pressure fluctuates constantly and can lead to misdiagnosis. A bout of stress or physical exertion can cause blood pressure to rise. Another factor that can skew the reading is the ‘white coat’ effect, linked to the stress of the consultation. In 30 per cent of cases,.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie prend la direction de la Bourgogne pour découvrir des races anciennes de volaille réintroduites en France grâce au travail de l’éleveur Fred Ménager. Nous nous rapprocherons ensuite de l’Auvergne pour découvrir comment est attribué le fameux Label Rouge et le rôle des organismes certificateurs … car il est important de savoir ce qui atterri dans nos assiettes. Julie se rendra aussi dans la Drôme pour cuisiner de la pintade avant de se diriger vers le Périgord pour préparer un civet de dindon. Installée dans sa petite Micheline, Julie remontera ensuite vers le centre pour découvrir un étonnant fabricant de mouche qui utilise des plumes de coqs !

programme.title: Health Investigation
programme.sub-title: Dietary Supplements: Healthy Dose of Misinformation?
programme.desc: Dietary Supplements: Helpful or Dangerous?They’re flooding the shelves of pharmacies, supermarkets, and health food stores. Brewer’s yeast, vitamins, passionflower, spirulina… More than one in two French people have already taken dietary supplements to get back in shape or stay healthy.A capsule for memory, a tablet for stress, a herbal detox programme… The promises made by dietary supplements are tempting. These products are guaranteed to be 100 per cent natural, which stands in stark contrast to the chemical image associated with medicines. But are they really effective and safe?The range of dietary supplements on offer is vast, with over 150 million packs sold in France every year. As summer approaches, many female consumers turn to slimming products. A flat tummy, slimmer legs… Their promises sound too good to be true, but are they actually effective for weight loss?Drug interactions, serious side effects… Dietary supplements can sometimes be dangerous, particularly as their qu.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Si l’été est la saison où les légumes abondent au potager, il serait dommage de ne pas savourer ceux que les saisons plus fraîches nous offrent : potages, tourtes, potées ou gratins mettent à l’honneur des légumes de saisons, idéals pour se réchauffer. Pour débuter ce nouveau voyage, un légume qui trônait déjà sur les tables de la Grèce Antique : le salsifis que Julie cuisinera avec une drôle de tourtière…L’hiver c’est aussi la saison du chou alors direction la Champagne pour y apprendre la recette de la potée locale qui devrait remplir le ventre d’un grand nombre de convives.Ce petit tour de France nous emmènera aussi à la découverte d’orfèvres du maraîchage qui sculptent légumes et fruits d’hiver, et vous présentera différentes techniques et méthodes pour sublimer vos potagers.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo cuisine un poisson de la Méditerranée, le rouget. Au menu : filets de rouget avec de la purée d'avocat et des carottes au cumin, et mille-feuille de rouget avec des légumes printaniers.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo welcomes Delphine Malachard, who is gluten intolerant. Together, they cook gluten-free recipes. On the menu: chocolate soufflé and vanilla and red fruit financiers.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: On se retrouve au parc National du Yellowstone aux Etats-Unis, il est situé dans le premier parc naturel créé au monde. Au Pérou, la forêt amazonienne est victime d’un déboisement massif. Le désert aux portes de Pékin est régulièrement touché par des tempêtes de sable. Certains experts prédisent que la capitale chinoise pourrait être menacée par les déserts d’ici cent ans. Dans le Montana, la productivité agricole américaine a un coût écologique et humain. L’ingénieur Marc Dufumier explique comment la mécanisation fragilise les équilibres naturels. Au Brésil les agrocarburants ont permis de réduire la dépendance au pétrole, de diminuer la pollution atmosphérique des villes et même de limiter les émissions de gaz à effet de serre. À Los Angeles, les activités humaines ont perturbé le fonctionnement de l’effet de serre et l’ont accentué. Aujourd’hui, la Terre chauffe.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Do wild animals still exist ? - Part 1
programme.desc: Animals represent 2/3 of the species on earth. We are increasingly concerned about our impact on the world. But what place does man have for the wild animal? Discover how it is possible to reintroduce wild animals in South Africa, or the disaster that took place with the sea lions in Namibia, and also how to preserve rhinos or other animals in biodiversity. There, women and men manage to protect wildlife every day.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: "The end of oil" is the amazing story of a raw material which has revolutionized man's life in just a century. But today, oil reserves are depleting. In his crazy race for always more production, Man didn't manage to preserve this precious energy that took million years for the Earth to give out. To tell the adventure of oil, Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team went to the United States, the country which depends the most on black gold. At the start of the 21st century, it is now urgent to realize that oil resources are limited. It's today that we have to act and get organized, in order to prepare the new era to come. While all our economies are based on the petrol barrel's price, we'll have to learn to do without oil within 20, 30 or 100 years. What will be the consequences? What are the solutions at stake? This new episode of Earth From Above attempts to answer these questions. From China to Benin, including Azerbaijan, Belgium and Canada, Earth From Above takes us on a new trip.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C’est à nouveau sur les routes de France que l’on retrouve aujourd’hui Julie pour parler d’un produit incontournable des tables françaises : le fromage. Plus qu’un engouement gourmand, plus qu’une friandise de fins de repas, le fromage est associé à l’image de la gastronomie française, et d’ailleurs reconnu patrimoine immatériel par l’UNESCO. Les français ne s’y sont pas trompés : avec près de 1 000 variétés - des pâtes molles, aux pâtes cuites, persillées, ou encore pressées, et avec 45 Appellations, nous sommes les plus gros consommateurs de fromage au monde !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen

programme.desc: Luana Belmondo gives you ideas for recipes that are easy to prepare using a wok! Thanks to this cooking method, you can create delicious, quick recipes using leftovers from your fridge or cupboard.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Kio og brødrene hans har kommet til en ny og farlig verden. Som den yngste er Kio den mest sårbare. Da de oppdager et frodig våtmarksområde med rikelig med byttedyr og en løvinneflokk, virker det som det perfekte nye hjemmet. Men dette paradiset har allerede sine konger. Et brutalt angrep splitter brødreflokken og tvinger Kio på flukt. Alene og forlatt er sjansene hans for å overleve små, men han finner mot til å rope og gjenforenes med brødrene. Sammen møter de en rekke prøvelser, fra bøffeljakt til kamper med rivaler, og knytter et ubrytelig bånd. Til slutt, som en selvsikker og nesten fullvoksen hannløve, vender Kio tilbake for å utfordre de gamle kongene. Seier sikrer ham et kongerike, en flokk og en ny familie. Nederlag betyr eksil. Vil Kio falle, eller vil han reise seg og endelig innta tronen?

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol

Hver hendelse blir grundig gjennomgått og forklart, noe som gir en intens, følelsesladet og lærerik opplevelse.

Helter og underdoger bytter roller, og naturens hjerteskjærende øyeblikk kan på et øyeblikk bli til storslåtte triumfer. På safari møter du naturens mest fascinerende karakterer.

Villhundene kommer tilbake for å utfordre maktbalansen, og når ei leopardmor risikerer livet for å forsvare ungene sine mot en løve, blir kampen om å overleve i naturen rå, brutal og nådeløs.

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: Spenningen stiger når en ung løveunge må komme seg forbi krokodiller og flodhester. Like i nærheten feller en stor løveflokk en fullvoksen bøffel, og turistene blir vitne til dramaet. Hannløver viker for flodhestene, mens elefanter forsvarer et vannhull og et skadd neshorn. Dette er safariopplevelser du bare får én gang i livet.

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: Bøflene forsvarer flokken sin mot løver. Elefantene viser hvor sterke de er når en stor okse utfordrer et kjøretøy fullt av mennesker. Et kappjordekorn ser døden i øynene, og hannløver angriper hyener. Rundt neste sving stjeler lekne dyreunger oppmerksomheten, mens en målbevisst krokodille jakter på elefanter natt og dag. Safariopplevelsene er intense, rå og ufiltrerte, og byr alltid på overraskelser!

programme.title: Wild Crocs of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Den sjeldne kubakrokodillen og dens amerikanske slektning møtes i Karibia.

programme.title: Crocodiles of the Okavango
programme.desc: I Okavangodeltaet i Botswana er en ung nilkrokodille mor for første gang. Etter å ha sikret seg muligheten til å pare seg, møter hun hard konkurranse om de beste hekkeplassene. I flere måneder må hun vokte eggene gjennom flom, stekende sol og stadige angrep fra rovdyr. Varaner, mungoer, bavianer og rivaliserende krokodiller utgjør alle en trussel mot reiret. Når ungene endelig klekkes, bærer hun dem forsiktig i munnen til et tryggere sted. Men farene er langt fra over. I dette vannlandskapet jakter selv krokodiller på sine egne, og bare noen få unger vil overleve. For den unge førstegangsmora kan alle valg være avgjørende i en verden der ingen unger er garantert å vokse opp.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: I Sør-Afrikas villmark blir dyrene desperate i de tørre vintermånedene. Sultne krokodiller sloss mot en farlig gruppe flodhester, flodhestene prøver seg på en gruppe hannløver, en honninggrevling kjemper for livet mot leoparder, og villhunder skaper komplett kaos hvor enn de går.

programme.title: Wild Crocs of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Den sjeldne kubakrokodillen og dens amerikanske slektning møtes i Karibia.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Dr. Pol og de ansatte må handle raskt for å behandle en rekke pasienter som velter inn på klinikken. Etter en rask titt på et sår, må dr. Pol til operasjonsstua for en hasteoperasjon. Mens dr. Nicole sliter med armene fulle av nydelige valper som skal undersøkes, kommer alles evner til nytte når nye tilfeller ankommer klinikken.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Fylkesmessen er i full gang. Dr. Pol er uoffisiell veterinær for arrangementet, der han sjekker dyrene før showet og auksjonen. Charles viser datteren noen av messens høydepunkter. På Pols veterinærklinikk er teamet opptatt med magesmerter, bistikk og unger. Dr. Nicole får et nødstilfelle da en shih tzu skader øyet.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Dyrlegene ved PVS tar seg av en rekke sommersår, fra en marsvin med en abscess til et reinsdyr med en uvanlig skorpe. En schæfer med alvorlige flenger og en valp med en øyeskade trenger dr. Nicoles ekspertise. Dr. Pol tar seg av en nedfor ku og en katt som ble påkjørt av en bil. Ti søte valper får kontrollert helsa og en minihest trenger øyeblikkelig hjelp.

programme.title: Wild Crocs of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Den sjeldne kubakrokodillen og dens amerikanske slektning møtes i Karibia.

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: På safari er dramatikken uforutsigbar, overraskende og rå. En løve fanger fugler i luften, en bavian stjeler en leopardunge, en hyene kjemper en dragkamp med en krokodille, mens en skilpadde jager en løve bort fra vannhullet sitt. Helter og underdoger bytter roller, og naturens hjerteskjærende øyeblikk kan på et øyeblikk bli til storslåtte triumfer. På safari møter du naturens mest fascinerende karakterer.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Kio og brødrene hans har kommet til en ny og farlig verden. Som den yngste er Kio den mest sårbare. Da de oppdager et frodig våtmarksområde med rikelig med byttedyr og en løvinneflokk, virker det som det perfekte nye hjemmet. Men dette paradiset har allerede sine konger. Et brutalt angrep splitter brødreflokken og tvinger Kio på flukt. Alene og forlatt er sjansene hans for å overleve små, men han finner mot til å rope og gjenforenes med brødrene. Sammen møter de en rekke prøvelser, fra bøffeljakt til kamper med rivaler, og knytter et ubrytelig bånd. Til slutt, som en selvsikker og nesten fullvoksen hannløve, vender Kio tilbake for å utfordre de gamle kongene. Seier sikrer ham et kongerike, en flokk og en ny familie. Nederlag betyr eksil. Vil Kio falle, eller vil han reise seg og endelig innta tronen?

programme.desc: Kråker er like smarte som delfiner og kan snakke som papegøyer. Ulv kan jakte i tre dager i strekk i områder like store som staten Delaware.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals: Høydepunkter
programme.desc: En tiger har tretten menns styrke og tungen deres er utstyrt med tenner. Isbjørner kan fornye sine egne bein og kan bære på kuren mot diabetes.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals: Høydepunkter
programme.desc: Vaskebjørner kan forandre formen på skjelettet sitt, mens en blekksprut pumper blodet rundt med sine tre hjerter.

programme.desc: I en øde del av Afrika er en familie med villhunder på rømmen. De er på desperat jakt etter et trygt sted til de seks ungene. Men fristedet er fullt av rivaler som står i veien for dem og rovdyr som vil ta ungene. Bare standhaftigheten til lederne, Teemana og Malao, kan redde dem.

programme.title: Villdyrenes rike
programme.desc: Bare de sterkeste kan regjere over kongeriket. Fem helter, alle med hver sin egenskaper, leder rivaliserende familier som kjemper om makten og klorer seg mot toppen. Vinnerne blir belønnet med de beste jaktmarkene i det afrikanske kongeriket, mens taperne lider en brutal skjebne - eksil eller døden.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: I planetens ville landskap bruker farlige rovdyr mer enn bare styrke for å holde seg på toppen av næringskjeden. programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: For å overleve ville landskap, matmangel og farlige rovdyr, trenger skapninger mer enn rå styrke for å overleve dagen. Dyr med superkrefter som en sjette sans klarer å få overtaket på hurtige bytter, overleve værforholdene og finne mat på usannsynlige steder.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Kamuflasje, mimikk og sniking er verktøy som brukes av de smarteste dyrene på planeten. Disse dyrene er bemerkelsesverdige bedragerimestere, fra tigre som bruker sin oransje pels som jaktkamuflasje, og en edderkopp som later som den er en maur for å snike seg inn i kolonien, til en fugl som bruke falske nødskrik for å lure surikater til å gi opp byttet sitt.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Enten de skal unnslippe farlige rovdyr eller bekjempe tøffe rivaler, så er ikke alltid rå styrke nok til å lykkes. Vi møter noen av planetens mest unike dyr som tar i bruk utrolige superkrefter, som akrobatikk som trosser døden, hemmelige sanser og skjulte våpen, for å overleve.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Når dyrene er i nød, trår veterinærene til. En hund som har blitt påkjørt må opereres med det samme, og valpesjekken gir dr. Nicole en stor overraskelse. Dr. Lisa behandler en ku med et stort sår i beinet samt en hund som ble angrepet. Dr. Pol tar imot to hunder med magebesvær og hjelper en merr med fødselen.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Pols veterinærklinikk tar stadig imot valper som ikke vil ta medisinen sin. Dr. Pol behandler tre geiter og en miniatyrhest, mens dr. Brenda undersøker et urolig reinsdyr. Veterinærene må jobbe overtid for å hjelpe hunden Tater etter at han har spist noe som kan være livsfarlig.

programme.title: Veterinærer i Midtvesten
programme.desc: Dyrlegene Schroeder samarbeider om en rekke saker, inkludert en fødende geit, en nedkjølt hest, og ei ku som sliter etter at hun har kalvet. Andre pasienter inkluderer en hund som krever øyeoperasjon og en kanin som ikke kan gå. Når Ben ikke pleier nødende dyr, verver Ben sønnene Charlie og Chase til å finne på en plan for å feire Erins bursdag.

programme.title: Veterinærer i Midtvesten
programme.desc: Dyrlege Erin behandler en golden retriever med en mystisk sykdom og fjerner en massiv svulst fra en middelaldrene mops. I mellomtiden behandler dyrlege Ben en familieand som har vært trist siden den mistet maken. Etter at dagen er omme, drar legene til en bankett for å motta en pris for sitt arbeid med å bevare det historiske sentrum av Hartington, Nebraska.
